entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return some shoes I bought.
I can certainly look into that. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Mountain Pro cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?
They just don't work. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times and they still give me blisters on every ride.
I'm very sorry to hear that they've been so uncomfortable. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I see here that the item was delivered 44 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you now.

Excellent. I have approved the return for a full refund. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Right. So I get to do all the work.
Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
